summary: TRINEX by TRINATH DESIGN STUDIO is a professional Turnkey Interior & Design Consultancy based in Hyderabad, delivering complete design-to-execution solutions for residential and commercial projects.
paragraphs: TRINEX by TRINATH DESIGN STUDIO is a professional Turnkey Interior & Design Consultancy based in Hyderabad, delivering complete design-to-execution solutions for residential and commercial projects.
Our primary focus is on Turnkey Interior Projects, where we coordinate the complete process from concept development and design to material selection, execution, finishing, and project handover.

Along with turnkey execution, TRINEX provides architectural design, 3D visualization, technical drawings, project documentation, estimation, and engineering support to deliver coordinated and practical project solutions.
We also work as a backend design and technical support partner for architects, interior designers, builders, and developers, helping them execute projects efficiently and professionally.

Complete project delivery with documentation and support.
